crossRefs.note: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king…
If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall…
The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came…
David said to him, “Don’t be afraid; for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will…
When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

translations.web: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”
translations.bsb: When the king asked the woman, she confirmed it. So the king appointed for her an officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, along with all the proceeds of the field from the day that she left the country until now.”
